join.title: Sign in to your XKnot
join.lede: Members sign in with the address given on the application. The code works once, and signing in shows this site's health, activity counts, and listing status.
join.emailHint: The address you gave on the application.
join.codeHint: Six digits, valid for 10 minutes, works once.
join.codeSent: Code sent. It expires in {ttl}; check spam if it does not arrive.
join.codeExpired: The code is wrong or expired. Request a new one.
join.notMember: This address is not a member yet. Deploy and submit using the steps below; approval takes effect on submission.
join.mailOff: This hub has no mail configured. Contact the operator.
join.rate: Too many attempts. Try again in a little while.
join.generic: That did not work. Try again later.
join.pendingNote: The entry is listed, and shows as live once the public /api/health passes.
join.howLede: Run a Knot on your own machine, then hand in the site's description. The portal no longer takes applications.
join.step1desc: Vibe Coding: install the project on your machine. Pick Node and the service manager for your system.
join.step2desc: Sign in with the admin token. Address and port follow your deployment. In the XKnot panel, fill in the site name, intro and contact, pick a subdomain (at least 6 characters), then hit Apply.
join.step3desc: xknot.si then talks to your Knot machine and finishes the configuration and checks. Anything that goes wrong shows in the XKnot panel of your admin console.
join.step4desc: Staff will email you if anything needs a decision. Keep that address right and reachable; you can also write to the xknot.si admin directly.
join.contactHint: Write here for opening, changes, or reinstatement.
join.terms: Federation terms: host no other instance's content, and keep accounts and data on your own machine.
